current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: Mostly cloudy. Low around 71, with temperatures rising to around 73 overnight. South wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Mostly Sunny then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of showers and thunderstorms after 3pm. Mostly sunny. High near 88, with temperatures falling to around 86 in the afternoon. Southwest wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain showers between 7am and 10am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 81. North wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Friday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 77. East wind 10 to 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Saturday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Showers And Thunderstorms then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms before 7am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 70. North wind around 15 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Sunday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Sunny, with a high near 73. North wind 5 to 10 mph.
